player_status_p1 ($10d52e) +$44: P1 hole stock, seeded by the PLAYER_START handler 0xe238 from the soft DIP HOLE(1st) $10fd88 (or HOLE(cont) $10fd8a + 1 when continuing); -1 at every hole_load (0x5ab82 from 0x5a15c), + |strokes - par| for an under-par hole and +3 for a hole in one (0x6d5da loop), +1 for the contest-hole record holder (jsr at 0x6d09c in 0x6cff4), MATCH HOLE tally +1/-1 (0x6c89e), -1 for a hole at or over the HOLE PENALTY threshold (0x6d5a2); cleared for the loser of a decided match (0xed52) and, on MVS with CONTINUE off, at 0xeddc; not a credit display; the P2 twin is 0x10d5d2
